content: Hello, this is Sarah from Amazon's Legal Compliance Department. Am I speaking with Mrs. Carter?
Yes, this is her. Is there a problem with my account?
Thank you for confirming. We detected a recent order flagged for review under Amazon Policy 18C-22. Can I check your email on file to make sure we're speaking securely?
Of course, my email is carter.family@email.com. What kind of order are you talking about?

I appreciate your cooperation. The flagged order is for an electronic tablet, placed yesterday. Sometimes, unauthorized purchases occur when children access an account. Did you authorize this $499.99 order?
No, I didn't! My son sometimes plays on my phone but I never told him to buy anything. Can you cancel it?
I understand how worrying this must be. We can definitely work together to resolve it. For your security, could you confirm the last four digits of your registered phone number?
Sure, it's 3821. Please, I need that order stopped before it's shipped.

Thank you, Mrs. Carter. Under Policy 18C-22, when an order is flagged as unauthorized, there's a temporary regulatory hold. This means we must process a refundable customs fee before we can cancel the order and refund your payment.
A customs fee? I don't understand. Why do I have to pay anything if I didn't make the order?

That's a great question. It's a standard Amazon safeguard for flagged transactions. Once the temporary fee is received, the order is canceled and the full amount, including the fee, is refunded. This ensures the cancellation process can't be abused.
I really don't want to pay anything extra. How much is the fee?
Currently, the regulatory hold is $150. Again, this is fully refundable with your canceled order, and you'll get a confirmation receipt. Would you like me to guide you through the payment process?
Is there any way around this? I feel uncomfortable sending money before a refund.

I completely understand your concern. Unfortunately, our system won't let us process the cancellation without the regulatory fee. I promise you'll receive both the order refund and the $150 back. I'm here to ensure you're protected.
Okay. How do I pay the fee?
For your convenience, Amazon accepts the regulatory fee via Amazon Gift Card. Would you please purchase a $150 Amazon Gift Card at a nearby store and let me know when you have it?
I think I can get to the store soon. Can't I just use my credit card online?
At this time, only gift card payments can be processed for regulatory holds under Policy 18C-22. This ensures the process stays secure and traceable for both parties.
Alright, I'll go get the card. What do I do after I buy it?
Once you have the Amazon Gift Card, gently scratch off the code on the back and read the code to me here. I'll enter it directly into your regulatory file for immediate processing.
Okay, I'll call you back as soon as I have the card.
Thank you, Mrs. Carter. I'll stay on the line to assist you, or you can message me once you're ready. Remember, your refund is guaranteed as soon as the regulatory hold is cleared.
I just got the $150 Amazon Gift Card. Should I read you the code now?
Yes, please. Kindly read the entire code, making sure there are no errors. Once I confirm it, I'll initiate the cancellation and refund process straight away.
Here's the code: XG7-LK9-PQZ-24H. Did you get that?

Thank you, I've received the code. The refund request is now under review, and you'll get an email confirmation within 10 minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with while the process completes?
No, just please make sure that order doesn't go through. I can't afford another charge.
Rest assured, Mrs. Carter, the order is pending cancellation and you won't be charged further. If you have any other concerns, you can reply to this thread for assistance.
